en: Black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) photograph of an ornate Gothic-style doorway set in a rough-plastered wall along a cobblestone street. Above the arched portal is a small balcony-like structure with decorative tracery and a statue of a robed figure in a niche. The door bears small signs and the doorway is marked with the number 5. At the bottom front margin, printed in red, is the caption naming the place in German.
